textRuns.value: With the addition of our new Dashboard, we're also releasing Power BI straight to your phone. A new Power BI app icon will soon appear on your phone that allows you to get alerts, notifications and have quick on the go access to the KPI's and even reports, right from your mobile phone. Although it's possible to view the reports associated with the KPI's on the phone, at the moment they won't be easy to display on the phone, this is something we're aware of and will work on in a future update. The main purpose of the Mobile Phone app at the moment is to grant you the ability to set up alerts or quickly have access to the KPI's.
